title: UE Material Editing
description: Batch material and function node edits, Custom HLSL correction, material instance overrides and bounded GraphIR queries with explicit preview, shader and save evidence.

recipes.title: Open, inspect, and select Material Editor state
recipes.description: Open or close a material editor explicitly, read its current selection and preview state, and select graph nodes by stable identity without editing or saving the graph.

inputs.name: assetPath
inputs.description: Exact Material, Material Instance, or Material Function asset path.

inputs.name: nodeIds
inputs.description: Stable expression or graph node IDs to select after the editor is open.

steps.purpose: Open the requested asset editor and capture the resulting editor identity.
Read current open-editor, preview, dirty and selection state before selection.
Resolve all requested node IDs before selecting them in the native editor; this does not edit, compile, apply or save.
Close the explicitly targeted editor when the workflow owns its lifecycle and read back the closed state.

result.summary: Material Editor lifecycle and selection evidence with explicit editor state.
success: editor operations target only the requested asset
selection failures do not partially select unresolved IDs
graph content and disk persistence remain unchanged

recipes.title: Inspect a bounded material graph
recipes.description: Capture the intended asset/preview and query sources or consumers with explicit coverage.

inputs.name: assetPath
inputs.description: Original material or function asset path.

inputs.name: targetContext
inputs.description: asset or editorPreview, matching the requested context.

steps.purpose: Capture the correct expression collection; opt into named reroute dependencies as needed.
Page/filter nodes and traverse within independent node, depth, edge and scan budgets.
Discover bounded property and pin templates without treating reflected fields as generic writable properties.
When comparing edits, recapture the same context/mode and page snapshots.diff; follow empty pages with hasMore.
Check coverage, truncation and immutable-source identity; release finished snapshots.

result.summary: Bounded graph evidence for the requested context.
evidence: bounded definition and writer contracts when requested
success: queries used the same snapshot
incomplete reference or traversal coverage was reported
boundary proof was reported as consumed by execute_plan when a plan was executed
no mutation, compilation or save was used for the query

recipes.title: Batch edits in an open material editor
recipes.description: Edit a working copy in one native batch and verify preview state without silently applying it.

inputs.name: assetPath
inputs.description: Original material/function path with an already-open editor.

inputs.name: operations
inputs.description: Requested create/configure/connect/delete operations.

steps.purpose: Read preview identity/graph hash and needed node settings.
Use editor.batch with current preview identity/state and one final refresh; no Apply/save.
Check batch business result and current same-context node/diagnostic evidence; prepare an Apply review when acceptance is requested.
After native Apply actually occurred, verify the prepared content receipt; this step does not perform Apply.

result.summary: Verified preview edits with explicit unapplied/applied status.
success: only the requested preview was changed
batch final update was not duplicated
shader success was scoped to available evidence
unapplied state and disk persistence were not conflated

recipes.title: Batch authored material and function edits
recipes.description: Use Workflow scopes for continuous authored changes with deferred updates, readback and rollback.

inputs.name: scopes
inputs.description: Material/materialFunction scope(s), including actual host when needed.

inputs.name: changes
inputs.description: Requested authored edits; use live Workflow admission.

steps.purpose: Read graph/node baselines for the authored scope, checking any open preview separately.
Plan and execute exact requested changes through material/materialFunction Workflow scopes; finalizer owns compile/readback/rollback.
Read intended node changes and current diagnostics. Do not compile again if Workflow already produced current validation.
Only when shader proof is still required, validate the actual host/material once and read its result.

result.summary: Authored batch with Workflow and scoped validation evidence.
evidence: scope identities and approved plan/run evidence
current host shader result and requested persistence
success: the exact Workflow admission/digest contract was followed
intermediate updates and saves were deferred by Workflow
a missing shader verdict was not reported as success
persisted state was distinguished from dirty memory edits

recipes.title: Batch material instance overrides
recipes.description: Set or clear scalar/vector/texture/switch overrides by full identity with inheritance readback.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: Exact material instance object path.

inputs.name: operations
inputs.description: Unique typed set/clear operations with association/index.

inputs.name: save
inputs.description: Persist explicitly when the requested outcome requires it; otherwise false.

steps.purpose: Read local/inherited/effective values and current state hash; keep full identities.
Preflight and apply one batch with expectedStateHash; use dryRun where useful and save only as requested.
Verify intended overrides or restored inheritance and inspect separate readback/save/restore receipts.

result.summary: Verified instance overrides with one final update and explicit persistence.
evidence: full parameter identities and effective/inherited values
readbackVerified, saved and restoreVerified when applicable
success: the batch used the current expected state
cleared overrides inherit the expected value
save/readback/shader evidence were kept distinct

recipes.title: Inspect and persist material utility state
recipes.description: Read bounded texture or shader statistics, request an explicit material recompile, and persist a standalone material when authorized.

inputs.name: assetPath
inputs.description: Exact material, material instance, or texture asset path.

inputs.name: onlyIfDirty
inputs.description: Skip a clean package when saving; defaults to true.

inputs.name: includeStats
inputs.description: Include bounded statistics after a recompile when the resource is complete.

steps.purpose: Read current shader statistics or texture metadata without requesting compilation.
Perform the explicitly requested recompile or package save; queries remain read-only.
Re-read statistics or texture metadata and report completion, availability, errors, dirty state, and persistence separately.
Optionally render a bounded thumbnail for visual evidence; file output is external evidence and is never required to prove the asset save.

result.summary: Material utility evidence with explicit compile, statistics, save, and texture metadata boundaries.
evidence: bounded compiler errors and statistics availability
package save outcome or texture metadata
success: queries did not trigger compilation
incomplete resources did not report invented statistics
memory compile state and disk persistence remained distinct

recipes.title: Inventory material instances and clear a parameter override
recipes.description: Enumerate authored material instances for a parent, then clear one named parameter override so it inherits the parent value.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.description: Exact Material or MaterialInstance object or package path to enumerate from.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: Exact UMaterialInstance object or package path whose override is cleared.

inputs.name: parameter
inputs.description: Exact parameter name; case-insensitive match.

inputs.name: recursive
inputs.description: Include instances whose parent ancestry reaches the parent; defaults to false.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.description: Bound the inventory to 1..4096 rows; default 256.

steps.purpose: Enumerate authored instances for the parent and read the target instance's current override/inheritance state.
Remove one named override from the exact instance so it inherits the parent value.
Re-read the instance parameters and confirm the cleared override now inherits the parent value.

result.summary: Bounded authored instance inventory with one cleared override and inheritance readback.
evidence: inherited value after the cleared override
success: only a named override on the exact instance was cleared
the inherited value was read back
inventory queries did not compile or save

recipes.title: Execute a bounded authored GraphIR plan
recipes.description: Apply an exact fresh GraphIR plan to an authored Material or MaterialFunction, then verify the new projection or roll back the whole batch.

inputs.name: assetPath
inputs.description: Exact authored Material or MaterialFunction path.

inputs.name: snapshotId
inputs.description: Immutable snapshot returned by content.material.graph.index.

inputs.name: expectedProjectionHash
inputs.description: Projection hash from the same snapshot.

inputs.name: operations
inputs.description: Ordered move_node, connect, disconnect, Material-only duplicate_node, or MaterialFunction set_function_metadata operations. duplicate_node may publish resultId/result_id for later operations in the same plan.

inputs.name: boundaryId
inputs.description: Optional writable boundary proof that constrains referenced expression nodes.

inputs.name: expectedAfterProjectionHash
inputs.description: Optional exact postcondition hash; mismatch triggers rollback.

steps.purpose: Capture the immutable graph and, when editing a bounded selection, derive a complete writable boundary.

Apply supported topology operations in one transaction after re-capturing the live projection. Material plans may duplicate_node with an explicit position or offset; MaterialFunction plans may also set_function_metadata (description, expose_to_library, library_categories) with property readback. Unsupported operations are rejected without mutation.
Verify the new projection hash and operation results, or verify that transaction rollback restored the pre-plan projection.

result.summary: Freshness-bound GraphIR topology execution with explicit commit, readback and rollback evidence.
success: the plan was applied only against its exact current snapshot
postcondition mismatch restored the original graph
unsupported operations were reported explicitly

resources.description: Preview batch identity, final refresh, rollback and native Apply boundary.
Authored Workflow scopes, finalization and actual function-host validation.
Typed override identity, inheritance and explicit persistence.
Immutable query coverage and current shader diagnostic interpretation.
